liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Reviewer always loves a 1984 Dupree's [20]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Reviewer considers this the best Wang Dang Doodle they have heard, remembered from an old lost tape [14]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Brent's B3 organ rolls on Black Peter were chilling as usual [17]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): Bobby blew a whistle around his neck; afterward Phil grabbed it and ran off, prompting a chant request [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-27.173710.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-10-27.178983.unknown.shotguns.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 152 min [2]
- **gd1984-10-27.168284.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 143 min [7]. Said about its sound: Several minutes of Drums remain missing, with no patch source available as of October 2023 [7]
- **gd1984-10-27.sbd.123743.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 43 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [10]. Said about its sound: Soundboard files are still somewhat decent; the tmp file belongs at the start, shifting all titles down by one [16]

## Around the show

- Bobby joked he had a whole box of whistles at home as Day Job began [13]
- Reviewer attended at 18 with a 17-year-old girlfriend, sat in the second row until the ticket holders arrived, and danced in the halls [15]
- Outside, Bill was handing out miracle tickets while a friend dosed people in line from a shared clean vial [17]
- Show is part of the six-night Halloween-ish run at Berkeley Community Theater ending the October '84 fall tour [20]
- Wang Dang Doodle in a second set is relatively rare [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-27.173710.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; Marantz Superscope mics > Sony WM-D6C (Maxell XLII-S90) [1]. Also: Jim Vita's Sennheiser 441 source patches parts of It's All Over Now, Me & My Uncle and Drums [1]
- **gd1984-10-27.178983.unknown.shotguns.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Unknown shotgun mics > Sony TC-D5M [2]
- **gd1984-10-27.168284.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > ?? > Jim Vita's cassettes (Maxell XLII-S) [7]
- **gd1984-10-27.sbd.123743.miller.flac16**: taped by Joani Waalker, Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Partial SBD > Cassette Master > Cassette > FLAC; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller [10]
